title: HubSpot search misses a record created seconds earlier, so dedupe logic creates duplicates
symptoms: Search returns total 0 for a contact created moments before
Duplicate deals or companies created by retry or webhook handlers
Same search returns the record a few seconds later
cause: Search reads from an index that is updated asynchronously, so new and updated objects can take a few moments to appear. Create-then-search or search-then-create flows race against that delay.
fix: Do not use search as the source of truth for existence checks right after a write. Look up by a unique property with idProperty, use batch upsert, or keep the id returned by the create call.
affected: HubSpot CRM search endpoints, all objects, as of 2026-10
